data.name: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller
data.detailed_description:
BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND), the Latest Entry in the Air Traffic Control Puzzle Series, Is Finally Here!
The first installment is set in Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), Japan's most iconic airport.

The game introduces two distinct ways to enjoy the airport: an Air Traffic Control Puzzle experience and an all-new Airport Exploration experience. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

Two Ways to Experience the Airport!

■ Tower Side – Play the Air Traffic Control Puzzle
Enjoy an air traffic control puzzle game where you will guide aircraft safely while managing the overall flow of airport operations as an air traffic controller.
*Not available in Demo Ver. 1.

■ Terminal Side – Experience the Airport Atmosphere
A brand-new feature has been added to the series, allowing you to experience the joy of simply visiting an airport.
Terminal Side is a new perspective that lets you experience the joy of visiting an airport itself. Step into the shoes of different airport visitors—from travelers to avgeeks—and enjoy spending time at the airport as if you were really there.

What is BOKUKAN?

Since its release in 1998, this air traffic control simulation game has established itself as a long seller, strongly supported by numerous users both inside and outside of aviation fandom.
For the safe flight of aircraft, air traffic controllers play a vital role. We focus on the duties of these controllers in our game scenarios.

Roadmap

Planned Features and Improvements:
  • Additional aircraft
  • Enhanced airport and scenery models
  • Additional time-of-day and weather options
  • Additional service vehicles and ground staff (NPCs)
  • Improvements to both the in-game and out-of-game UI
  • Expanded explorable areas in Terminal Side
  • Improvements to the apps available in Terminal Side
  • Additional apps for Terminal Side
  • New missions for Terminal Side
  • New Achievements for Terminal Side
  • Additional Tower Side (Air Traffic Control Game) content
  • Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese language support
*The order of the items listed above does not indicate development priority or release order.

Plans for Modding and Creation Tools
We're also exploring the development of modding and creation tools, including support for aircraft texture customization and scenario creation.

Please note: Features, content, and release timing are subject to change and are not guaranteed. Development priorities may also change due to technical or other unforeseen circumstances.
